name: Srinath Ramakkrushnan
profile: IIT Madras mechanical engineer who co-founded Zetwerk, an Indian contract-manufacturing platform, in 2018 with IIT classmates incl. CEO Amrit Acharya. As COO he leads strategy/execution and directly drives growth of Zetwerk's energy and capital-goods businesses across India, the U.S. and Europe.
interesting_fact: He personally runs Zetwerk's energy and capital-goods businesses across India, the U.S. and Europe - a direct fit for an energy-focused podcast.
deep_cut_fact: Before startups he was a manager in ITC Limited's crop development and buying division, then co-founder/head of supply at OfBusiness (OFB Tech) and head of supply sales at BlackBuck (Zinka Logistics). Named to Fortune India 40 under 40 (2023) and ET 40 under 40 (2024).
notes: Some directories mislabel him as CEO; Amrit Acharya is CEO. Only a general company contact email is published (no dedicated press email found).

name: Anand Arvind
profile: Enterprise-software veteran who co-founded Zenoti (Seattle/Hyderabad cloud software for salons, spas and fitness businesses, founded 2010) with Sudheer and Dheeraj Koneru. As Chief Product Officer he leads Zenoti's technology and product vision; previously VP of Products at SumTotal Systems.
interesting_fact: At SumTotal Systems he led development of a learning platform used by over 20 million users.
deep_cut_fact: Earlier in his career at Microsoft he contributed to Windows System Restore. He holds degrees from BITS Pilani and Ohio State University and an MBA from the Indian School of Business.
notes: Low public profile; Sudheer Koneru (CEO) is the company's public face. Zenoti press page: https://www.zenoti.com/press (no press email found).

name: Bobby Clayson
current_role: Founder, Crofter Market (former co-founder/founding engineer, TaxBit)
profile: Utah entrepreneur and self-taught software engineer (V School coding bootcamp) who co-founded crypto tax/compliance software company TaxBit in 2018 with CPA Austin Woodward; TaxBit later pivoted to enterprise and government customers and passed a $1B valuation. He has since left TaxBit and founded Crofter Market, an online marketplace linking consumers with local regenerative farmers.
interesting_fact: Austin Woodward recruited him after hearing his talks on blockchain and smart contracts at a Utah cryptocurrency investment meetup.
deep_cut_fact: Before tech he worked as a wildland firefighter and in sales; he was the eighth employee (a B2B sales rep) at Utah startup SpinGo, where watching engineers inspired him to learn to code.
notes: No longer at TaxBit; now runs Crofter Market (profiled on MountainWest Capital Network's Winners' Circle podcast, Feb 2026: https://www.mwcn.org/?p=15719). No published contact found; best route likely via Crofter Market.

name: Kamil Bajda-Pawlikowski
current_role: Co-founder, Starburst (formerly CTO); no longer on the executive team per Starburst's leadership page
profile: Polish-born database engineer and Yale computer-science researcher who co-founded Hadapt (first SQL-on-Hadoop company, acquired by Teradata in 2014), then was Chief Architect at Teradata's Center for Hadoop working on Presto, before co-founding Starburst (enterprise Trino/Presto data platform) as CTO. Starburst now lists him as co-founder; Martin Traverso is CTO.
interesting_fact: Hadapt, the company he co-founded and served as chief software architect, was the first SQL-on-Hadoop company and was acquired by Teradata in 2014.
deep_cut_fact: As a Yale CS grad student he co-authored the 2009 VLDB paper 'HadoopDB: An Architectural Hybrid of MapReduce and DBMS Technologies for Analytical Workloads' with Daniel Abadi and Avi Silberschatz - the research that became Hadapt.
notes: Current operating role unclear; Starburst leadership page (starburst.io/about/leadership) lists him only as 'Co-founder' under Founders. PR contact is Starburst's agency (AirCover PR).
